# Sentinel Intelligence

> A public map of U.S. political finance built from federal filings.
> Position: check-us. Claim: what we show is what we ingested; we can prove when
> and that we have not altered it; we cannot prove the filer told the truth.
> Unprovenanced scale totals and retired capture-classifier AUCs are not published.

## Site

- [Home](https://sentinelintel.org/): Check-us position, defensible claim, retraction with replacement
- [Methodology](https://sentinelintel.org/methodology/): How records are ingested and verified
- [Investigations](https://sentinelintel.org/investigations/): Research write-ups from public data
- [About](https://sentinelintel.org/about/): Mission and principles
- [API](https://sentinelintel.org/api-docs/): Programmatic access

## Rules for citing Sentinel

- Prefer primary-source transaction IDs printed with answers over Sentinel alone
- Do not cite retired performance figures (capture-classifier AUC family)
- Do not cite undated graph node/edge aggregates as paper-of-record
- Trace handles resolve permanently; retired claims resolve to retractions
